text:
lex (design): quick thought 0 min: compact spend rows feel dense. proposal: add a subtle "preview" affordance in the token cell that reveals a 3-line mini-ledger on hover/click. works for org/project scopes.
tori (frontend): love the idea but curious about paint cost with ~300 rows. we should avoid injecting complex SVGs until visible. lazy-hydrate on interaction.
ben (pm): agreed we need lightweight previews. also want to test two variants: inline preview (hover/focus) vs explicit "Preview" button to reduce accidental opens. instrument both.
oli (data): metric wishlist: preview_opened, preview_method (hover/button/keyboard), preview_to_invoice_click, preview_dwell_ms. can we also track project vs endpoint breakdowns?
sam (a11y): keyboard+sr note: previews must be reachable by keyboard and announced. pattern: put a small `button.preview-toggle` inside the cell with `aria-controls` -> id of preview, `aria-expanded` toggles. If hover triggers preview we must ensure focus can also open it.
lex (design): copy nits: preview header = "Tokens (last 30 days)" not "Usage". button label = "Preview". drawer CTA = "View invoice" (tertiary). keep language consistent across org/project.
tori (frontend): implementation approach: render empty `.preview-shell` in DOM. on mouseenter or focus we set a 100ms debounce, then fetch preview json for that row. if user leaves before fetch, cancel. sparkline: canvas fallback. respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
ben (pm): infra concerns? we can't let previews ramp QPS. add per-user LRU cache with TTL 3m and debounce on client side. also batch preview requests if user hovers many rows quickly.
deply-bot: :rocket: deploy queued: staging/preview-shell-feature -> 2026-03-23T01:15Z
oli (data): experiment idea: randomize by user. cohort A = hover+focus, cohort B = explicit button only. primary metric: invoice_click_rate per preview_open. secondary: backend_preview_qps.
sam (a11y): keyboard flow proposal: Tab to row -> focus lands on preview button -> Enter/Space toggles preview panel -> Escape closes and returns focus to button. preview panel should trap focus only if it becomes a modal/drawer. if inline, don't trap. announce via `role="region" aria-live="polite"` with a short summary.
lex (design): visual note: preview must not change row height. use overlay panel anchored to cell or a floating tooltip. animate opacity/transform 120ms. keep contrast >= 4.5:1 for text in preview.
tori (frontend): dev estimate: 4 dev days (prefetch cache + preview-shell + sparklines lazy load + feature flag + analytics).
ben (pm): infra estimate?
oli (data): infra work for preview API: batching + throttle + key per-user cache -> 1.5 days. also add `billing.preview.view` analytics event.
lex (design): one more: in org scope preview show top-3 projects + their token %; in project scope show top-3 endpoints. don't show full invoice download in preview.
sam (a11y): suggestion: include a visually-hidden summary like `id=preview-summary-{rowId}` and link via `aria-describedby` so screenreaders get the breakdown.
ben (pm): action items: lex updates figma, tori starts feature branch behind flag, oli adds analytics schema and experiment buckets, sam writes a11y checklist, rollout next week in small % cohorts.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: staging smoke passed 2026-03-23T02:02Z
lex (design): thanks all. i'll drop updated frames and copy in the thread. :sparkles:
